items.title: Jim Cramer Explained Adobe Inc. (NASDAQ:ADBE)’s Share Price Movement
items.summary: Cramer has discussed productivity software Adobe Inc. (NASDAQ:ADBE) several times over the past couple of months. Some of the factors that have crossed his mind include the impact on the firm’s products from Apple and its software-as-a-service business model. The shares gained 7% between August 17th and August 19th. Cramer discussed the share price movement […]

items.title: Snowflake, Varonis Systems, Fastly, Adobe, and DocuSign Stocks Trade Up, What You Need To Know
items.summary: A number of stocks jumped in the afternoon session after quarterly earnings and upbeat corporate commentary signaled that artificial intelligence is driving growth across enterprise software rather than threatening legacy business models.

items.title: Figma Stock Price Prediction: Wall Street’s $30 Target May Be Too Low
items.summary: Figma has lost more than half its value since IPO even as revenue growth accelerated, creating a rare tension between a beaten-down chart and fundamentals that are quietly getting stronger. Here is why the setup may be more interesting than the headline numbers suggest.

items.title: Software and Chip Stocks Surge in AI-Fueled Earnings Blowout
items.summary: Software and semiconductor stocks are high-flying in morning trading on the backs of stellar Salesforce, Crowdstrike and Nvidia earnings Wednesday.  Salesforce is up more than 20%. The software giant said it was deepening its partnership with Anthropic, boosting investor confidence in its ability to integrate AI into its software.

items.title: Figma Spikes 12% as AI Turns From Threat to Tailwind for Design Software, Atlassian Rallies 8%
items.summary: Investors spent most of 2026 punishing design software names on fears that AI would hollow out their business models, but something shifted Thursday morning and Figma and Atlassian are suddenly leading the market higher.

items.title: Here are the companies leading the software comeback against OpenAI and Anthropic
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi debates with Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre, Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management Company CIO Brent Schutte and Laffer Tengler Investments CEO & CIO Nancy Tengler on whether the so-called "SaaSpocalypse" is over. Salesforce (CRM) and CrowdStrike (CRWD) stock both surged a day after positive earnings reports.

items.title: Salesforce Soars 14% as Claudeforce and a Guidance Raise End the Slump, ServiceNow Climbs 5%, Adobe Advances 3%
items.summary: Salesforce spent months as the broken name in enterprise software, dragging the sector's AI credibility down with it. Now one earnings report and a surprise Anthropic partnership are forcing the bears to rethink everything.

items.title: Latest News In E-Commerce - Global Online Grocery Market Poised for Significant Growth
items.summary: Urbanization, digital payment adoption, and the demand for convenient home delivery are key drivers in the expansion of the global online grocery market, which is expected to grow from USD 0.96 trillion in 2025 to USD 1.74 trillion by 2031. The industry's development is being shaped by consumer preferences for digital solutions like mobile-first shopping and subscription services that enhance the grocery buying experience.
